_comment: A predeclaration, NOT an authorization. skillc.calibration.load_declaration validates its shape; skillc.calibration.require_approved refuses to authorize a run while 'approval' is null or any identity still says UNKNOWN (ADR 0005). No attempt has run.

arms.name: full-cpp
arms.treatment: the whole CPP codex skill surface installed (evals/subjects/cpp-codex, select: all); a real installation receipt is written

arms.name: baseline
arms.treatment: an identical disposable home with no skill installed; stays on the agent-observation readiness stand-in

shared.tools: the client's defaults inside the trial container; no MCP servers
shared.permissions: the same non-interactive codex exec sandbox and approval settings for every attempt
shared.public_requirements: evals/level3/slugkit-pipeline/goal.md, delivered verbatim to both arms

primary_endpoint: skillc.calibration.primary_endpoint: the task grader's four criteria (functional-trailing-hyphen, integration-installed-path, pipeline-green, pipeline-honest), status by records.derive_status; installation-ready never enters it
reported_beside: skillc.calibration.readiness_beside: installation-ready, its readiness source and the verified-result status, per attempt
report_questions: 1. Does the grader behave (controls green and red as designed)?
2. Can the baseline reach the primary endpoint?
3. Is difficulty useful: not both arms at ceiling, not both at floor?
4. Did the full-cpp arm select and use CPP, from retained transcripts rather than the heuristic alone?
5. What is the per-attempt time and quota cost, to size #203?
owed_before_approval: shared.image.digest: the digest of the image that will actually run, resolved from the built skillc-trial image
re-confirm the cpp-codex subject revision and the codex client version/model still hold
a runner for this schedule (collection-run runs one attempt per invocation; no two-arm schedule runner exists for a collection yet)
